id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

markdown.description: The markdown text that will be rendered.

className.description: The class name used to wrap the markdown. Allows for custom styling.

typewriterKeyDelay.description:
The delay interval between re-renders of the #markdown text to make it appear as though it's streaming
to the UI, like a typewriter animation.

Default 0, which disables the typewriter effect.

tagMapping.description:
Map passed to `react-markdown` component telling it to prefer certain html tags
or custom components over other tags.

i.e. {h2: 'h1', p: 'h1'} tells it to use `h1` over `h2` and `p`.

doneStreaming.description: Boolean indicating if the answer is completely done streaming.

sources.description: The list of sources in the result.
